content: Developer tunneling tools follow consistent public-exposure UX patterns: off-by-default (all tools default private/tailnet-only); VS Code shows a caution warning when setting a port to Public visibility and shows Public badge in Ports panel; ngrok shows an interstitial page to every visitor on free tier ('content served via ngrok, do not enter sensitive info unless you trust the sender'); Tailscale Funnel triggers a web-based approval interface. Persistent indicators are the norm (Ports panel badge, status output). One-click teardown: 'tailscale funnel <port> off' or reset subcommand.
